# an allocation guessed at Stage 1 before anything existed -- while the app
# slots sat at 92% full. That space moved to the app slots.
# APP OFFSETS MUST BE 64KB ALIGNED. gen_esp32part.py enforces

# filesystem -- 192KB rather than the 128KB originally aimed at. Shrinking
# the filesystem further would NOT buy more app space; it would just strand
# the difference as an unusable gap.

# ESP_PARTITION_SUBTYPE_DATA_SPIFFS (0x82) for filesystem OTA and would
# Moving the app offsets means this cannot be reached by OTA -- it needs one
